feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: iteration 9 reproduced the iteration 7 best design exactly (score 75.92; oval progress 0.2725 with max_error at the 0.06 floor; s-bend 0.1573 with oscillation 0.135; slalom 0.1094 with 1.0 line loss per run). That makes iteration 9 the comparison point. Iteration 4 (wheel_track 0.10 at y = 0.07) gave oval progress 0.1175, the same as the 0.12 track, so narrowing the track did not lift the oval at that lead. It also raised s-bend oscillation to 0.164 and slalom losses to 0.95. So the oval is not a turn-authority problem at y = 0.07, and the step to 0.11 at y = 0.08 is a test with uncertain payoff. Integration note: I changed nothing in the controller. The 25-per-metre weights and kp 3.0 are unchanged, so the narrower track gives about 9 percent more yaw per unit of controller output. That is the main risk on the s-bend, where the oscillation margin at y = 0.08 is 0.015 under the 0.15 limit. Decide the next step from the per-track telemetry: if s-bend oscillation is at or below 0.15 and slalom line losses are at or below 1.0, the 0.11 track is safe. If the oval progress also rises above 0.2725, keep it. If s-bend oscillation exceeds 0.15 or slalom losses rise above 1.0, return to 0.12 in iteration 11.
requested_changes: If the next race shows s-bend steering_oscillation above 0.15 or slalom line_loss_events above 1.0 at wheel_track 0.11, restore wheel_track 0.12 for the final race with all other fields as in iteration 9. Evidence: iteration 4 at wheel_track 0.10 raised s-bend oscillation to 0.164 and slalom losses to 0.95 at y = 0.07.

If the next race keeps s-bend oscillation at or below 0.15 and slalom losses at or below 1.0 but oval progress stays at 0.2725 or below, do not narrow the track further. Keep wheel_track 0.11 only if oval progress rises. Evidence: at y = 0.07 the oval progress was 0.1175 at both 0.12 and 0.10 track widths, so narrowing alone may not lift the oval.

Do not change mass in the final race. If oval progress falls well below 0.2725 at wheel_track 0.11, the cause may be the same sensitivity seen in iteration 8, so keep mass 0.6. Evidence: mass 0.5 at y = 0.08 dropped oval progress from 0.2725 to 0.12 (iteration 8).
